notes: Read the full 101-line numbered source before editing. Web imports (L1-3): react-i18next useTranslation, cn from @/lib/cn, and the web <Tooltip> — none have a native parity surface, so useTranslation becomes a local fallback hook returning the inline English string (react-i18next is not in the native deps; same approach as the DataFreshness/Speed ports), cn is dropped because RN has no className (className retained on props for source compatibility, destructured as _className), and <Tooltip> is replaced per native-safe rule 7 (see below). The L5-21 module JSDoc describing the l1/l2/log/stale layer contract is condensed into the native header comment and preserved as the descFallback strings.

SignalSource union type (L22) and SourceLayerBadgeProps interface (L24-31: source, ageMs JSDoc L26, showLabel JSDoc L28-29, className L30) are ported verbatim, with native-only style?:StyleProp<ViewStyle>, testID, and 'data-testid' added for parity consumers (mirroring the DataFreshness port). The STYLE map (L33-64) is ported with identical keys (l1/l2/log/stale/unknown), labels (L1/L2/LOG/STALE/—), descKey, and descFallback; the Tailwind/CSS-var `tint` string (L35,41,47,53,59) is split into native bg/text/border literals: bg-emerald/blue/amber-500/15 and border-*/30 use the exact 16,185,129 / 59,130,246 / 245,158,11 rgba tints with text-emerald/blue/amber-200 = #a7f3d0/#bfdbfe/#fde68a; the log+unknown CSS vars resolve to the web dark-theme values --surface-2 #151621, --text-secondary #9ca3af, --border-strong rgba(255,255,255,0.2), --border-subtle rgba(255,255,255,0.06).

formatAge (L66-73) is ported byte-for-byte including the null/!isFinite guard, the 1000/60_000/3_600_000/86_400_000 thresholds, the ms/s/min/h/d suffixes, and the toFixed(1)/Math.round precision. The SourceLayerBadge component (L75-101) preserves the variable names key (L77, source??'unknown' lowercased) and the STYLE[key]??STYLE.unknown lookup (L78, web local renamed style→layer only to avoid colliding with the added native style prop), ageText (L79), and the tooltip ternary (L80-82) including the t(style.descKey, style.descFallback) call and the '(age: <ageText>)' suffix using the t('sourceLayer.age','age') key.

Native-safe substitution for the unavailable browser-only <Tooltip> (rule 7): the web hover tooltip (L85) is rendered through the View's accessibilityHint=tooltip (the same title→accessibilityHint mapping used in the Speed.tsx port), with accessibilityLabel=layer.label and accessible so screen readers announce the layer + description + age. The hover-on-pointer affordance itself does not exist on touch/native and is documented here as unavailable. The web <span> (L86-98) becomes an AppText glyph inside a View chip: data-testid='source-layer-badge' (L87) maps to testID (default 'source-layer-badge'), data-source={key} (L88) is preserved via accessibilityValue={{text:key}}, and the className list (L89-95) is reproduced with native styles — inline-flex items-center justify-center→flexDirection row + alignItems/justifyContent center, rounded→borderRadius 4, px-1.5 py-px→paddingHorizontal 6/paddingVertical 1, border→borderWidth 1, font-mono→Platform.select monospace fontFamily, uppercase→textTransform uppercase, text-[10px]→fontSize 10, tracking-wider→letterSpacing 0.6, leading-none→lineHeight 10, and min-w-[2.5rem]/min-w-[1.5rem] (L92)→badgeWide minWidth 40 / badgeNarrow minWidth 24 gated on showLabel. style.label (L97) is the rendered glyph.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only React, type-only react-native StyleProp/ViewStyle plus Platform/StyleSheet/View, and the existing apps/native AppText primitive (rule 5). Verified gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) all pass.
